svg.title: Air quality technician — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as air quality technician, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: An air-sampling unit has a tall inlet mast and round indicator beside a separate two-stage filter cartridge. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a tapered face.
